NIST Special Database 4
NIST 8-Bit Gray Scale Images of Fingerprint Image Groups
Craig I. Watson, National Institute of Standards and Technology

Dataset citation:
Watson, C. (2008), NIST Special Database 4. NIST 8-Bit Gray Scale Images of
Fingerprint Image Groups, National Institute of Standards and Technology,
https://www.nist.gov/publications/nist-special-database-4-nist-8-bit-gray-scale-images-fingerprint-image-groups
(accessed October 31, 2026).

The original database was distributed in 1992. This subset uses the later NIST
PNG distribution. Original PNG bytes are preserved. On October 31, 2026,
OpenPhysical decoded selected PNG files losslessly to tightly packed grayscale
bytes, preserving all 512 x 512 pixels. The manifest describes these derivatives
and reference outputs generated with original NBIS 5.0.0 tools.
